ios.desc:
Ever wanted a friend who's always there for you? 

Bring your idea friend to life. Your friend will text you throughout the day, share updates about what they're up to, and send you photos just like a real friend would.


What makes this different:


Your AI friends don't just sit around waiting for you to message them. They have their own lives. They post stories, send you random texts, and actually react to what you share with them.


Features:

- Get matched with your ideal bestie
- Chat about literally anything, anytime
- See their daily updates and stories
- Jump on video calls with them
- Get reactions and comments on your own stories
- Discover other users' friends and add them too

Whether you want someone to vent to at 2am, a hype friend who gasses you up, or just someone to share your day with, they're here waiting for you.
Your new best friend is ready to meet you.
